description: This file implements the Moondream vision service which integrates a vision-language model for image analysis and description generation within the project. It includes model loading, device detection, and the main analysis method.

classes.name: MoondreamService
classes.description: A service class that uses the Moondream vision-language model to analyze images and generate descriptive text, supporting hardware acceleration options.

methods.name: detect_device()
methods.description: Detects and returns the optimal hardware device and data type for model inference based on available hardware acceleration.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, model="vikhyatk/moondream2", revision="2025-01-09", use_cpu=False, **kwargs )
methods.description: Initializes the MoondreamService, loads the model with specified configurations, and sets up the device with optional CPU usage.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_vision(self, frame: UserImageRawFrame)
methods.description: Asynchronously analyzes an image frame, generating a descriptive text using the model, and yields relevant response frames.
